text: In the once-stagnant kingdom of Economica, Queen Analytica sought to revitalize her realm by introducing her people to the invisible forces of supply and demand. As the citizens engaged in commerce, their everyday experiences became an allegory for complex economic principles, illustrating market equilibriums, shortages, and surpluses in a way that made abstract notions of fiscal policy and trade balance accessible to all. Amidst this bustling economic transformation, the kingdom’s vitality was sustained by its most vital organ, the heart, which pumps blood to keep every subject alive and active in their new commercial endeavors.
